name: wttj-cli
description: CLI for searching Welcome to the Jungle (France) job listings via the site's public Algolia search index — no authentication, zero runtime dependencies. Endpoints are swappable via WTTJ_ALGOLIA_APP_ID / WTTJ_ALGOLIA_API_KEY / WTTJ_ALGOLIA_INDEX / WTTJ_API_URL if the public key rotates.
